maria: Quick Q — SDK behavior for streaming retries when we get 429 / 5xx and auth refresh races. Do we prefer idempotency header + resume token, or client-side dedupe? Trying to write guidance for JS/Go SDKs.
alex: Prefer idempotency header for non-stream requests, and resume tokens + offsets for streaming. Auth refresh must not silently replay without idempotency.
sam: For JS streams: handle backpressure + racey auth. On 429 -> exp backoff with jitter and obey Retry-After if present. If stream aborted due to auth refresh, surface a distinct error code so app can decide to retry. :thinking_face: 
rachel: Agreed. Proposed backoff params: base=500ms, factor=2, max=10s, jitter=full. Pseudocode below:
```js
const backoff = Math.min(base * 2**attempt, max) * (0.5 + Math.random());
await sleep(backoff);
```
alex: Also enforce idempotency header for replays: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` and for streaming add `X-Resume-From: <cursor>` so server can resume without duplication. When auth refresh happens, client should reuse same Idempotency-Key for retried work.
sam: Go nuance: prefer context.Context cancellation. When retrying, create a fresh request with the same Idempotency-Key and copy resume token. Watch out for http2 stream resets — treat as retryable only if idempotent or has resume token.
rachel: On 5xx: treat as retryable but more conservative. For streaming: try reconnect + resume token up to 3 attempts, then escalate to client error. Non-idempotent endpoints: retry only on safe status codes or when Idempotency-Key present.
maria: Quick question on Retry-After semantics — if server returns Retry-After, should SDK pause exactly that long or still apply exponential backoff/jitter?
alex: Respect server Retry-After as a minimum delay. Implementation: delay = max(retryAfterSeconds, backoffWithoutJitter) then apply jitter within a small window. That keeps server guidance but avoids thundering herd.
devex-bot: FYI: draft doc added to the repo under /docs/retries-streaming.md — will post link in #docs once PR is up.
rachel: UX note — error objects should include { retryable: true|false, reason: 'rate_limit'|'server_error'|'auth_refresh', retry_after: <s?> } so integrators can make decisions.
sam: I'll open a tiny PR to add X-Resume-From handling and Idempotency-Key behavior for go-client. @maria can you review when ready?
maria: On it. Also please add a unit test that simulates an auth refresh mid-stream and asserts no duplicate side effects. Thanks all! :+1:
